fieldValues.title: Charter: WG Agent-supported editor
fieldValues.decision_question: Does the owner delegate the WG Agent-supported editor mandate on the terms in the group role and its four standing orders?
fieldValues.decision_statement: Ratify: the group role and its standing orders (membership and quorum, cycle and report, budget, reporting and minutes) are the mandate of the WG Agent-supported editor working group (semanticops.com#29). Ratifying also asserts the delegates relation from the Owner role. Amendments need a new owner decision.
fieldValues.rationale: semanticops.com#29; drafted by the clerk charter command as the acting actor, for an owner session to ratify.

createdBy.name: Orchestrator (drafting a charter for owner ratification)
